name: nebula-kirana-store
description: Indian Kirana Store POS & Management System

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm install --prefix bot
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT,BOT" -c "cyan,green,yellow" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client" "node bot/bot.js"
